Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Sales & eCommerce Operations Specialist position at Wolf Oil Corporation. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, analytics, and e-commerce content management, I am excited about the opportunity to support your international distribution networks and e-commerce ambitions.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in data-driven decision-making, building dashboards, and optimizing online performance. I am proficient in Excel, Power BI, and have experience with SQL and database querying. My hands-on experience with WordPress and e-commerce platforms, combined with my analytical mindset, aligns well with the responsibilities of this role.

I am particularly drawn to Wolf Oil's commitment to innovation and collaboration. I am eager to contribute to your team by transforming data into actionable insights and supporting strategic growth initiatives.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit Wolf Oil Corporation. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
